scope: initialize and tools/list only; no target attachment or authentication

result.instructions:
When inspecting UI:
- Use "attach-to-app" when the user app process is running and can be connected
- Use "attach-to-file" when the user asks to inspect, preview, or check a specific XAML file

Prefer "attach-to-app" unless tasked with designing or debugging XAML files in isolation.
Benefit of "attach-to-app" is that you don't need to navigate to the specific XAML page,
but disadvantage - requires user project to work with previewer in design time, headlessly.
If connection failed, do not ask user to press F12 - it has zero effect on MCP.

Node IDs from tree/search are used with other tools. Don't show NodeId values to the user.
If attached XAML was changed, invalidate node IDs by calling tree/search again.  

Make sure that user project references AvaloniaUI.DiagnosticsSupport (2.2.3 or newer) package to enable DevTools support.
Additionally, `WithDeveloperTools(this AppBuilder)` or `AttachDeveloperTools(this Application)` must be called on app startup.

tools.name: props
tools.description: Gets property values for a node.

propertyNames.description: Names to filter. Omit for all.

tools.name: input
tools.description: Sends an input event to a UI element.

arg.description: Text or key to send for Text/Key events.

tools.name: set-prop
tools.description: Sets a property value. Use 'null' or 'unset' for special values.

tools.name: styles
tools.description: Gets applied styles and setters for a node.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Captures a PNG screenshot of a UI element.

tools.name: assets
tools.description: Lists embedded assets (images, fonts). Returns URLs for open-asset.

tools.name: open-asset
tools.description: Downloads asset by URL from assets tool.

tools.name: attach-to-file
tools.description: Connects to Avalonia previewer with specified XAML file. Prefer it over attach-to-app for previewing XAML files.

xamlProjectPath.description: Path to the project to associate XAML with.

build.description: Build the project before launching previewer.

tools.name: resources
tools.description: Gets resources. Optionally scoped to a node.

nodeId.description: Scope node ID. Omit for Application resources.

onlySelf.description: Only resources defined on the node itself.

tools.name: action
tools.description: Performs an action on a UI element.

action.description: The action to perform on the node.

tools.name: attach-to-app
tools.description: Connects to a running Avalonia app. Lists apps if no processId and multiple available.

id.description: App identifier. Omit to list available apps.

tools.name: tree
tools.description: Gets child elements. Null nodeId returns roots.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Finds elements by type or x:Name.

scopeNodeId.description: Scope node ID, or unset for all.

tools.name: pseudo-class
tools.description: Sets pseudo-class. Omit pseudoClass to list available.

pseudoClass.description: Pseudo-class, examples: pointerover, pressed, focus, disabled, selected.
